notes: Teaching-moment-lands check (no check_strategy_tie_in rule_index, per template): the named teaching moment — 'STRIDE's value is rejection, not enumeration,' operationalized as name-the-worst-case-first then pick — reliably triggers. Trace Phase 2 (the moment itself) scores 9/10 with zero confusion_flags, and the forcing function sits inside the prompt fence (verified under check_pedagogy rule 16 above), so a persona that skips body prose and pastes only the prompt still lands the moment. A less-skilled persona variant (skips the 'name the worst case first' framing bullet) would still hit the forcing function because the prompt itself instructs 'Start by proposing the most plausible incident story... then map that story' — the sequencing is enforced by the prompt's own structure, not by the student having read the framing bullet first. Judged robust across reasonable persona-skill variation.
